name: Kinoko Machi: Kinoko Chinchin Kokufuku Shuukan
original_name: きのこまち きのこチンチン克服週間
source:
Once upon a time a great famine struck this land, but suddenly appeared mushrooms became salvation for population.
Nowadays people continue to live in coexistence with mushrooms. There is even a festival where millions of yen are given to a person who finds a talking mushroom. Main characters lives in a town where mushrooms are everywhere, so he hates them. He leads a happy student life and finds a girl he wants children from. But mushrooms never leave him at peace...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
